FULL TEXT:
COMPUTER OPERATOR-CUM-TYPIST RECRUITMENT EXAMINATION, 2026
NOTICE
No.- 61/R&A Dated: 19th August, 2026
In continuation to Court’s Notice no. 44/R&A dated 29.07.2026, it is hereby
informed to all concerned that objections were invited from the candidates who had
appeared in the Computer Based Written Test held on 22.07.2026 (Wednesday) under the
Computer Operator-cum-Typist Recruitment Examination, 2026 (Advertisement No.
PHC/02/2026) in two shifts, against the Provisional Model Answer Key of Multiple Choice
Questions. After due deliberation, all the objections so received have been found to be
invalid.
Accordingly, the Provisional Model Answer Key published with the aforesaid notice
shall be treated as Final Model Answer Key for preparation of the result of the
examination.
The candidates are advised to keep visiting the Court’s website regularly for further
details/updates
By order
Sd/-
Registrar General
